events.title: Allegations against Snehal Jadhav (Madha)
events.body: Snehal Jadhav, our candidate in Madha, is accused of a land deal. The story comes with documents. Rivals are already sharing it. We never vetted this candidate.

options.label: Stand by the candidate
options.detail: Call it a smear and back them fully.
options.risk: If the evidence holds, the story grows and drags the party.

options.label: Order an internal inquiry
options.detail: Buy time and look serious. Costs ₹1 crore.
options.risk: Looks evasive to some; the result comes in two weeks.

options.label: Drop the candidate
options.detail: Replace them with a party organiser.
options.risk: Weaker candidate; their faction will be angry; they may run as a rebel.

options.label: Say nothing for now
options.detail: Let the news cycle move on.
options.risk: Silence can read as guilt if the story has legs.

events.outcome: Hetal Patel, a party organiser, is our new candidate in Madha.

inbox.subject: Briefing: 2029: The Next Mandate
inbox.body:
You lead the All India Trinamool Congress. We have 8 weeks until polling day and ₹120 crore in the war chest.

The first two weeks are preparation: tickets, manifesto and alliance terms lock at the end of week 2. After that, every rupee and every leader-day counts.

A reminder about the arithmetic: 272 seats is a majority, and seats are won one constituency at a time. A big national vote share spread thinly can still lose.
